lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A repeating grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into distinct vertical and horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form high-contrast grid nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal features visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5 to 8 discrete high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple elongated, high-luminance trailing structures attached to the posterior-ventral margin of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant transition in spot morphology from large, grid-aligned blobs on the flank to a high-density field of micro-blobs on the anterior cephalic region.
